issue_context.title: Hang (deadlock?) with horizontal concat and filter
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [x] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [x] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example


```python
import datetime as dt
import polars as pl

def f(frame, n_frames):
    frames = [
        frame
        .filter(pl.lit(True))
        .select(pl.lit(0).alias(str(i)))
        for i in range(n_frames)
    ]
    return pl.concat(frames, how="horizontal")

frame = pl.LazyFrame(dict(x=[0], y=[0]))

for i in range(100):
    print('***', i)
    output = f(frame, n_frames=10)

    print(dt.datetime.now(), 'start collect', flush=True)
    output.collect()
    print(dt.datetime.now(), 'end collect', flush=True)
```

### Log output

```shell
*** 0
2025-03-06 12:08:55.872691 start collect
found multiple sources; run comm_subplan_elim

dataframe filtered

CACHE HIT: cache id: 0
CACHE HIT: cache id: 0
CACHE HIT: cache id: 0
CACHE HIT: cache id: 0

*** 1
2025-03-06 12:08:55.877383 start collect
found multiple sources; run comm_subplan_elim
HCONCAT: hconcat is run in parallel
```

### Issue description

The given code will hang in almost always less than 10 iterations of the loop. It doesn't use any significant CPU after hanging.

I have tried to minimize the example. It doesn't hang within 100 iterations if I:
- call concat with parallel=False
- change it to a vertical concat
- reduce n_frames low enough (e.g. n_frames=2, although n_frame=5 still hangs)
- remove the filter (even though the filter doesn't affect the output)
- remove a column x or y from the frame (even though those columns aren't used in the computation)
- make the frame have length 0 (but with 2 columns still)

The only similar issue I could find is  #9310.
